title: Bundled dependency index and atomic promote/rollback controller for air-gapped sites
author: Anika Rao
release_notes:
- Add bundled dependency index manifest for offline installs
- Introduce atomic promote controller to enable zero-downtime bundle switch and deterministic rollback
- Terraform module tweaks for registry seeding and ACLs
description:
Motivation: Customers operating in fully isolated air-gapped environments requested a simpler, auditable mechanism to compose and promote runtime bundles atomically and to perform deterministic rollbacks without relying on external registries. This PR introduces a bundled-dependency index (compact YAML/JSON manifest) that enumerates component images, checksums and version constraints, plus a lightweight promote/rollback controller that performs atomic bundle activation on the target cluster.

What this change does: adds a new 'bundled-index' manifest format and generator (cli: rhub-bundle index), implements a PromoteController that validates bundle checksums, prefetches sealed credentials to a local sealedsecret store, and swaps runtime configmaps/helm releases in a single transaction with a promote annotation. If a promote fails, the controller runs the rollback path using the last-known-good index entry. The terraform module that seeds a local OCI mirror has been extended with a 'seed_policy' flag to allow optional ACL scoping and pre-seeding verification hooks. Finally, Helm chart and values schema changes allow operator-driven promotes (chart values.promote.enabled).

Backward compatibility and upgrade notes: existing airgap users are not forced to change; the bundle index generator is additive. Upgrades: operator will not auto-promote without explicit annotation; cluster administrators must run `rhub bundle index --manifest` and `kubectl apply` the bundle or use the new `rhub promote` helper. We include a migration script (tools/migrate/legacy-to-index.sh) that converts older sealed-bundle layouts into the new indexed format.

Checklist:
- [x] Bundle index generator (CLI) implemented
- [x] PromoteController with atomic swap + rollback path implemented
- [x] Helm chart values and RBAC for controller added
- [x] Terraform module extension for registry seeding and ACLs
- [x] Documentation updates and example playbook (docs/airgap/promote-playbook.md)
- [x] Integration tests: local mirror + promote/rollback scenario

Testing performed: unit tests for index parsing and checksum validation, e2e on KIND with a seeded OCI registry (simulated offline mirror), manual test of promote followed by induced failure to validate rollback path. Performance: index parsing and manifest apply are sub-second for typical bundle sizes (~200 artifacts); promote controller performs batch secret prefetch with backoff to avoid saturating local registry.

Security notes: the promote flow ensures signed index files (ed25519) are verified against a configured key in the installer KMS path. Sealed credential fetching respects RBAC and logs access via audit events. The migration script warns if unsealed secrets are found.

Limitations and future work: current promote controller assumes manifests fit in a single ConfigMap/Secret (we will add multi-chunk support in follow-up). We also plan to expose atomic promote as a Helm hook to integrate with operator-managed releases.

review_comments:
Rafael Jimenez: Overall design looks solid. Can we have a clear failure-mode diagram in the docs? Also please gate the controller RBAC more narrowly (namespace-scoped) — avoid cluster-admin.
Author reply: Added namespace-scoped RBAC and a failure-mode appendix in docs (see docs/airgap/appendix-failures.md).

Priya Sharma: The migration script touches secrets; can we add a dry-run mode and stronger warnings?
Author reply: Added --dry-run to the migration script and an explicit checklist in the playbook.

Liam O'Connor: CI flaky on e2e when registry seeding is slow; suggest increasing backoff and adding idempotency in seeding step.
Author reply: Increased backoff, made seeding idempotent and added retries to e2e test harness.
merge_outcome: Merged by Anika Rao via squash merge. Squash commit message: 'airgap: add bundled index + promote controller (ENG-9274)'. Release train: included in 2026.03.1; no migration downtime required when operator is deployed but not promoted.
